app_info.subtitle: Manage CDC pipelines
app_info.description: Artie helps data teams set up, monitor, and operate change-data-capture pipelines from databases and APIs into warehouses. Use it to check connector compatibility, create and start pipelines, inspect table metadata, monitor lag and throughput, detect schema drift, and manage supporting infrastructure like SSH tunnels and PrivateLink connections—all within your authenticated Artie environment.

test_cases.description: Monitor overall pipeline health including status and per-table state.
test_cases.user_prompt: Is my production Postgres-to-Snowflake pipeline healthy right now? Show status and any tables that look stuck.
test_cases.expected_output: Resolves the pipeline by name, reports lifecycle status flags, and summarizes per-table state without pausing, resuming, or backfilling.

test_cases.description: Check ingestion lag and row throughput for a running pipeline.
test_cases.user_prompt: What is the ingestion lag for my orders pipeline over the last hour?
test_cases.expected_output: Identifies the pipeline UUID and returns per-table lag and row counts for the requested time window.

test_cases.description: Set up a draft CDC pipeline from saved source and destination connectors.
test_cases.user_prompt: Create a new Artie pipeline from my saved Postgres production source to my Snowflake warehouse destination using the public.orders and public.users tables, but leave it as a draft.
test_cases.expected_output: Uses saved connector UUIDs, creates a draft pipeline with a dedicated source reader, selects the requested tables, and saves destination landing settings without starting replication.

test_cases.description: Discover source tables through a saved connector before pipeline changes.
test_cases.user_prompt: List my source connectors and show tables available on my Postgres production connector.
test_cases.expected_output: Returns saved source connectors, then table names from the selected connector UUID suitable for pipeline table selection.

test_cases.description: Detect source schema drift on a running pipeline without applying DDL.
test_cases.user_prompt: Check whether my prod Postgres pipeline has any source schema changes waiting.
test_cases.expected_output: Resolves the pipeline UUID and requests schema-drift detection without applying automatic schema changes to the destination.

negative_test_cases.description: Do not trigger for unrelated calendar scheduling.
negative_test_cases.user_prompt: What meetings do I have tomorrow?
negative_test_cases.expected_output: The app should not be invoked because calendar scheduling is outside Artie pipeline management workflows.

negative_test_cases.description: Do not trigger for arbitrary warehouse SQL analytics.
negative_test_cases.user_prompt: Run SELECT COUNT(*) FROM analytics.revenue WHERE date = yesterday on Snowflake.
negative_test_cases.expected_output: The app should not run ad hoc SQL queries; it manages Artie replication pipelines rather than acting as a query engine.

negative_test_cases.description: Do not trigger for public social posting.
negative_test_cases.user_prompt: Post an update to LinkedIn that our migration finished.
negative_test_cases.expected_output: The app should not be invoked because it does not publish content to social networks.
